notes.title: Version 0.9.8a Update (2018/5/8)
notes.content:
[h1][b]Bugs Fixed[/b][/h1]

1. The bug that, the equipped skill “Thunder” will be removed after restarting the game, is fixed.

2. The bug of incorrect automatic target lock-on for channeling skills(such as Beam of Ice), is fixed.

3. The setting error of Steam Achievements is fixed.

4. The character and skill settings for certain enemies are modified.

[h1][b]Game experience & balance improvements[/b][/h1]

1. Certain UI designs and the operations are improved.

2. The model of weapon “Damasc Maul” is replaced.

3. Remove the unnecessary path-finding function executions to increase the loading speed of the game.

notes.title: Version 0.9.8 Update (2018/5/2)
notes.content:
[h1][b]New Contents[/b][/h1]

1. Chapter 5 of story mode is available (the end of main story).

2. 13 new Unique Gems are added, which can be acquired in “Tower of Trials” mode.

3. 2 new potions are added, which can be acquired in “Tower of Trials” mode and equipped in “Skill” menu.

[h1][b]Bugs Fixed[/b][/h1]

1. The direction turning error, which occurs during enemy generation, is fixed.

2. The HP bar display error, which occurs when player or the companions die, is fixed.

3. The bug that, the enemy mark in the mini map might remain even after the enemy dies, is fixed.

4. The bug that, when a revived companion dies again, the character can not be revived anymore, is fixed.

5. The error of weapon “Demon Maul” model is fixed.

6. The category and skill setting errors of weapon “Crystal Staff” are fixed.

7. The incorrect description and numerical setting error of skill “Cure” are fixed.

8. The incorrect description and casting effect error of skill “Frozen Armor” are fixed.

9. The casting effect error of skill “Thunder” is fixed.

10. The problem of certain sound effects being staticky are fixed.

[h1][b]Game experience & balance improvements[/b][/h1]

1. For those rare Monster Gems with “Health” effect, the maximum value of HP regeneration is decreased from 4% to 2%.

2. When casting a skill, the character will lock on and attack the enemy within the attack range automatically.

3. The animation of “Frozen” debuff is improved, and the effect is adjusted from 100% frozen to 35% chance frozen, and an extra 100% slow effect is added, lasting 2 seconds.

4. The Boss of Chapter 2, The Dragon, has higher diversity in attacking mode, which now includes a new skill: Fire Breath.

notes.title: Version 0.9.7b Update (2018/3/31)
notes.content:
[h1][b]Bugs Fixed[/b][/h1]

1. The error that some quests cannot be completed is fixed.

2. The animation bugs of crossbow skills are fixed. 

3. The bug of invalid animation settings for certain magic skills is fixed.

4. The error of the background music in Tower of Trials is fixed.

5. The turning movement abnormality of AI companions is fixed. 

6. The viewing angle error of the view field lock-on for bosses is fixed. 

[h1][b]Game experience & balance improvements[/b][/h1]

1. Now the Steam Achievement and the quest menu in the game will show the achieved level in Tower of Trials for the assigned character.

2. The viewing angle option configurations is improved.

3. The completion process of battles in Tower of Trials is improved.

4. When the summoner dies, the summoned creatures will die at the same time.

notes.title: Version 0.9.7 Update (2018/3/26)
notes.content:
[h1][b]New Contents[/b][/h1]

1. Chapter 4 of story mode is available.

2. New equipment added: six weapons, one shield and five armors.

3. “Tower of Trials” mode major update: “Tower of Trials” and story mode now use the same set of character, equipment and Monster Gem data. There are 3 trials available. (For those quests regarding Tower of Trials, if the quests had been completed, it will remain completed. For those not completed yet, the completion of the quests follows the requirements of new system.)

[h1][b]Bugs Fixed[/b][/h1]

1. The AI-controlled companions will bypass the obstacles when use ranged attacks or skills.

2. The AI-controlled companions will now try to attack the enemy you are aiming for.

3. The lasting time error of certain buffs are fixed.

4. The category setting of skill “Sprint” are changed from “Bow” to “Magic.”

[h1][b]Game experience & balance improvements[/b][/h1]

1. The setting of viewing angle switch will be kept when proceeds to the next region or goes back to the village.

2. The skill and animation variety of boss Griffin the Stormy are improved.

3. The skill casting frequency of certain monsters are decreased.

4. The skill set of character Euclid is adjusted, with more skills available.

5. Certain scenes are improved.

6. The values of certain weapons are adjusted.

notes.content:
[h1][b]New Contents[/b][/h1]

1. English and Simplified Chinese are supported.

notes.title: Version 0.9.4 Update (2018/1/24)
notes.content:
[h1][b]New Functions[/b][/h1]

1. Companion revival function: Players can revive dead companions in 1 minute after the death by consuming golds, and the revived companions will be transported to the character controlled by players; the corresponding keys for keyboard users are “O” and “P”, and for joystick users are “Y” plus “← and →” arrow key.

[h1][b]Game experience & balance improvements[/b][/h1]

1. Joystick control improvement.

2. Other UI design improvements.

1. The position of pop-up hints for obtaining golds and items is adjusted. 

2. The critical strike rate of skill “Righteous Blow” is changed from 100% to 50%.

3. Viewing angle of scenes is adjusted.

4. The AI of companions is improved.

5. Background musics of scenes are improved.

notes.title: Version 0.9.2 Update (2017/12/27)
notes.content:
[h1][b]System[/b][/h1]

1. Amount of MP consumption of skills are shown in the Skill page.

2. Certain UI texts are changed to Chinese for clarity:

3. The growth curve of HP, which is determined by “VIT” attribute, is adjusted.

4. The bug of abnormal high basic attributes of Luna is fixed. [Not that we have certain preference for this character, just an unintentional mistake.]

5. Parameters of certain equipment are adjusted:
A. “Mithril” weapons: SP increase is adjusted from 200 to 100
B. “Mithril” armors: S increase is adjusted from 100 to 50
C. The amount of MP consumption of attacks with staffs / wands is adjusted from 15~20 MP to 1 MP
D. The beneficial effects of staffs / wands for SP and MP are adjusted upwards

6. The bug of character model abnormality when certain character is equipped with certain weapon is fixed.

7. Monster Gem destruction: don’t have to equip a gem first to destroy it, you can destroy the gems in the gem list.

8. The overall strength of monsters in main story mode is mildly adjusted upwards.

[h1][b]“Tower of Trials”[/b][/h1]

1. The bug that the BOSS – Lich on level 25 will cease fire when its HP is down to certain level, is fixed.

2. Overall strength of monsters is adjusted.

[h1][b]Character Skills[/b][/h1]

1. Emil & Luna: the bug that the effective range of skill “Whole Healing” is too short to be observed, is fixed.

[h1][b]A forecast of the update of version 0.9.3[/b][/h1]

1. “Unique Gems” function will be embedded into this update. These Unique Gems can be equipped at the bottom of Monster Gem page, and only two are allowed for each character. Once equipped, it will infuse the character with unique passive skill effects.

2. We plan to embed “Commission” function (like side quests). When players use certain characters to complete the novice challenge on level 25 in Tower of Trials, and come back to finish the Commission in main story mode, players will be awarded with corresponding Unique Gems, which can be used to face the challenges in Chapter 2.

3. We are testing the details of contents in Chapter 2, and the difficulty & rewards of the “Ceaseless Challenge” from level 26 to 35 in Tower of Trials as well. We’re also working on the translation of the game. Since we have only 5 people in the team, we mainly release updates with higher frequency but less changes.

notes.title: Version 0.9.1 Update (2017/12/20)
notes.content:
Version 0.9.1 Update

[h1][b]System[/b][/h1]

1. The cursor under character’s feet is modified to be indicating the direction of attack, rather than the direction of movement.
2. The prices of weapons & armors (including shields) and the effects of armors are adjusted.
3. The damage reduction effect of Defense Gems is adjusted.
4. Certain UI texts are changed to Chinese for clarity.
5. Character Info page shows the armor value and reduction percentage of characters.
6. Skill effect descriptions become more detailed.

[h1][b]“Tower of Trials”[/b][/h1]

1. The bug of abnormal level limit after finishing Level 25 in Tower of Trials is fixed.
2. The bugs of the attack and summon skill of Lich are fixed. 
3. The bug of Monster Gem amount limit is fixed.
4. The amounts of silver coins acquired for selling certain equipment are adjusted.

[h1][b]Character Skills[/b][/h1]

1. All characters will learn new skills at Level 1, 3, 7, 10, 15, 19 ,20 and 22, but some characters will learn extra new skills at Level 27.
2. The skill sets of certain characters are modified.
3. “Burning” Debuff: targets with Burning Debuff will receive damage and the amount of damage is depending on the SP of the attacker. 
4. Ella’s skills:
   “Parry”: the effect of damage reduction is fixed.
   “Fanatic”: The effect of attack speed increase is adjusted from 20% to 100%, and the cooldown is adjusted from 6 seconds to 20 seconds.
   “Berserk”: The effect of AP increase is adjusted from 30% to 70%, and the cooldown is adjusted from 6 seconds to 20 seconds. 
5. Emil & Luna’s skills:
   “Divine Favor”: The cooldown is adjusted from 6 seconds to 20 seconds. 
   “Whole Healing”: The cooldown is adjusted from 3 seconds to 15 seconds, and MP consumption is adjusted from 120 to 60. The amount of healing is depending on the SP of the caster.
